title: Register kache-action in zizmor cache-poisoning audit
body:
Parent: #844

## Why

zizmor's cache-poisoning audit already knows `actions/cache`, `Swatinem/rust-cache`, `Mozilla-Actions/sccache-action`, and similar. Publishing workflows that use `kunobi-ninja/kache-action` are not classified as cache-aware, so the audit cannot recommend the safe restore-only setting.

## Current state

`kache-action` already has `save-cache` (default `true`). `save-cache: false` is restore-only and, with S3, also disables remote uploads. That is the control zizmor should treat as the automated remediation for publishing jobs.

kache-action is not present in `crates/zizmor/src/audit/cache_poisoning.rs`.

## Work

- [ ] Open an upstream zizmor issue/PR registering `kunobi-ninja/kache-action`
- [ ] Map `save-cache: false` as the opt-out (same shape as other configurable cache actions)
- [ ] Integration test in zizmor's cache-poisoning suite
- [ ] Document restore-only publishing in kache-action README once zizmor recognizes it
